description_en: Queries network bandwidth monitoring data for Domain Names
description_zh: 查询域名网络带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun vs describe-vs-domain-bps-data --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 2021-12-26T16:00:00Z --end-time 2021-10-02T02:30:48Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en guangdong --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVsDomainBpsData

parameters.help_en: Domain Names. If this parameter is empty, the system returns merged data for all accelerated Domain Names. Enter the accelerated Domain Names to query. Separate multiple Domain Names with commas
parameters.help_zh:
域名，若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后数据
可输入需要查询的加速域名
支持批量域名查询，多个域名用逗号（半角）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time for data retrieval. The date format follows ISO8601 notation and uses UTC time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If not specified, the system reads data from the past 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
最小数据粒度为5分钟
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time must be later than the start time. The date format follows ISO8601 notation and uses UTC time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间需大于起始时间；获日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time granularity for query data. Supports 300, 3600, and 86400 seconds. If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the system uses 300 seconds by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的时间粒度，支持300, 3600和86400秒。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The English name of the carrier (ISP). Obtain this from the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp interface. If not specified, the system queries all carriers (ISPs)
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传为所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. Obtain this from the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp interface. If not specified, the system queries all regions
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传为所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval for each record. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔。单位：秒
